title: Add a product
text: Use Add Product to create one item in your product list. You need a name, barcode, cost, and selling price. The rest is optional.
steps: Click Sidebar > Products, then Product List.
Click Add Product.
Under Product Info, type the name and barcode. Add an SKU if you use one.
Under Pricing, type the cost and selling price. The markup is filled in automatically.
Under Organization, choose the category, unit, and shelf.
Under Tax & Discounts, choose the tax. Under Stock, type the starting quantity if you have it.
Click Save at the bottom. The item will then appear in the list and at the register.

title: Import products from a file or another branch
text: Import Products lets you add many items at once. You can upload an Excel or CSV file, or copy products from another branch.
steps: Click Sidebar > Products, then Product List.
Click Import Products in the top bar.
Choose Upload file and pick your Excel or CSV file, or choose a branch to copy from.
Click Map columns and match each column in your file to a product field.
Click Review & import and check the preview.
Click Import. Nothing is saved until you confirm it.

title: Edit many products at once
text: Bulk Manage shows your products like a spreadsheet. You can update prices, costs, and names in one place.
steps: Click Sidebar > Products, then Product List.
Click Manage, then Bulk Manage. This works best on a desktop screen.
Type directly into the cells. Changed rows are highlighted.
Click Save. Large lists are saved in batches. If one batch fails, your edits stay on screen so you can try again.

title: Categories
text: Categories are product groups such as Drinks or Snacks. The same category list is shared across branches.
steps: Click Sidebar > Products, then Product List.
Click Manage, then Categories.
Click Add to create a new category. Use the pencil to rename it or the trash icon to remove it.
Choose the category on each product form.
To filter the list, click a category in the left panel.

title: Shelves and units
text: A shelf tells you where an item is stored in the store. A unit tells you how it is sold, such as kilo, piece, or box.
steps: Click Sidebar > Products, then Product List.
Click Manage, then Shelves & Units.
Add the shelves and units you use.
Choose them on each product form under Organization.
Use the All Shelves filter to view one shelf at a time.

title: Edit or delete a product
text: Each product row has a menu at the end. Prices are set per branch, so edits only affect the branch you are currently viewing.
steps: Click Sidebar > Products, then Product List.
Find the product using the search box or by scanning its barcode.
Click the arrow at the end of the row.
Choose Edit, change the fields, and click Save.
Choose Delete to remove it. Confirm when asked.
Note: Deleting a product does not remove it from past sales. It only stops the item from being sold in the future.

title: Export or print the product list
text: Print & Export lets you print what is on screen or save it as PDF or Excel. The import template is available in the same menu.
steps: Click Sidebar > Products, then Product List.
Set your search and category filters first. The printout will match what you see on screen.
Click Print & Export in the top bar.
Choose Print, PDF, or Excel.
If you need the import template, pick it from the same menu.
